db.acilamadi: {{ad}} could not be opened ({{hata}}). It is being retried in the background; if it persists, restart the device, and if it still persists, contact technical support.
db.eskiKokGocu: {{ad}} was not opened: the records in the old data folder could not be moved to the new folder (the file may be locked, the disk may be full or its key may be different). No empty database was created and the old file is preserved; the move is being retried in the background and at every start. Do NOT delete the old file: close any program keeping it open (antivirus, backup), check the free disk space and restart the device; if it persists, contact technical support (the data migration line in the log shows where the old file is).
db.goc: {{ad}} is waiting for migration: the at-rest encryption migration was not completed (the file may be locked); the file is preserved and was not quarantined. The migration is being retried in the background; if it does not clear, restart the device.

hata.cihazDisiGeriYukleme: There are records on this device: a restore (it replaces all treatment records on the device) can only be done from the device's own screen.
hata.cihazaKaydetEkran: Saving the backup to the device can only be done from the device's own screen; on this client the file is downloaded.
hata.cihazaYazilamadi: The backup file could not be written to the device or could not be verified — the backup was NOT CREATED. Check the disk space and that the desktop folder is writable.
hata.disaAktarBasarisiz: Export failed — the backup was NOT CREATED.
hata.dogrulanamadi: The backup file could not be verified; the created file cannot be opened. The operation was cancelled — please try again.
hata.geriYuklemeHastaOkunamadi: This device's patient records could not be read (the patient database cannot be opened) — the restore was NOT PERFORMED and the records on the device were NOT CHANGED. Restart the app; if the problem persists, contact technical support.
hata.geriYuklemeOnay: This device already has records. A restore DELETES ALL treatment records on this device (sessions, coil runs, sensor data, session events, AI analyses) and replaces them with those in the backup. Patient cards are NOT deleted: the cards of patients not in the backup stay, but their session and analysis history on this device is deleted. To confirm, send {"confirm":"REPLACE_ALL"}.
hata.geriYuklemeSurerkenSeans: A restore is in progress on this device — the session was NOT STARTED; start it again when the restore finishes.
hata.geriYuklemeSuruyor: A restore is in progress on this device — the records will appear when it finishes. Do not repeat the action and do not restart the app; refresh Session History in a few minutes.
hata.geriYuklemeYazilamadi: The restore COULD NOT BE PERFORMED — the treatment database could not be written (busy or disk error). The records on the device were NOT CHANGED. When the process using the database (maintenance, a second app) finishes, you can restart the restore.
hata.hastaOkunamadi: Patient records could not be read (the patient database cannot be opened) — the backup was NOT CREATED. Restart the app; if the problem persists, contact technical support.
hata.kodlama: The file could not be read (invalid encoding).
hata.seansSurerkenGeriYukleme: A treatment session is running — a restore replaces all treatment records on the device (the running session's record would be deleted too); stop the session first. No record was changed.
hata.yedekAlmaSuruyor: A backup is in progress on this device — wait for it to finish (it can take a few minutes for a large clinic); do not repeat the action.
